record.reason: A rain-fed lake that is fullest and most pleasant from the end of the monsoon through winter. In summer it shrinks and the heat is hard going.

review.why: All 3 sources that name months include Nov-Mar (2 of them also include October).

evidence.quote: October to March is ideal for visiting.
monsoon and winter months ... primarily rain fed lake

review.decide: Add October? Two sources say Oct-Mar, one says Nov-Mar.

record.reason: Best in the cool, dry winter months. The lake shrinks in summer. It sits in a wildlife sanctuary, so the Forest Department sets access and safari timings.

review.why: All 3 include Nov-Feb; the edges differ (Oct-Mar, Oct-Apr).

record.reason: Pleasant from October to March; April and May are very hot. Sri Rama Navami (March-April) and Vaikunta Ekadasi (December-January) bring very large crowds. Heavy monsoon rain can affect travel.

review.why: All 4 sources include Oct-Mar (2 say Sep-Apr).

record.reason: Pleasant from October to March; April to June is very hot. The Brahmotsavam in Phalguna (February-March), weekends and holidays are very crowded.

record.reason: Winter is best for sightseeing and summer is very hot. The spillway gates open only after a good monsoon (often September-October), a big sight that depends on the year's rain.
